name: steal-privileged-pods-v1

attributes.m$K8sThreatMatrix: Credential Access::Steal pods from privileged namespaces

description: determines which subjects can both remove pods from privileged namespaces such as kube-system and make other nodes unschedulable, letting them force powerful pods to reschedule onto a node they already control and read the service account tokens of those pods
remediation: Split pod removal and node maintenance rights between separate subjects so that no single subject holds both. Where node maintenance is required, avoid granting update/patch on nodes and nodes/status alongside delete on pods, create on pods/eviction, or update/patch on pods in kube-system and other privileged namespaces.
